observations: Historical residence legal holdings, effective-dated occupancy transitions, household membership and private billing are distinct authorities. Gateway projections derive observer-specific holding visibility and hide owner billing dates from other occupants. Acquisition, recovery, designation and occupancy admissions need complete producer and error-boundary traces.

Historical billing orders all active holdings by due minute and records per-period charges; paid deadlines advance with saturating time arithmetic and an unpaid rental becomes dormant. Clock exhaustion, zero-cost or affordable period conditions, cash conservation and caught NPC recovery failures remain open pending explicit current and policy analysis.

Generated property registration validates a catalog and immutable digest, allocates households and represents unmaterialized census residents separately from named occupancy. Later materialization groups named family members and selects an available aggregate home. Capacity, aggregate transfer, household identity, legal tenure and chronological future intervals need connected reconciliation.

The historical residence authority fixture and source tests were read as source only and not executed. Their assertions are not validation evidence. No current source, historical alias or recovered checkpoint 3821 status follows from these reads.
